summary: Campaign 3B scientific repair: shared versioned prompt/tokenization contract proving training/inference token parity; frozen answer-only output contract with strict exact match primary and format/termination diagnostics recorded separately; oracle-verified training replay (L5b) as an operational non-neural baseline with L5a preserved as the honest negative; family-aware statistics with undefined metrics reported as NOT_ESTIMABLE rather than zero; a governed eight-category safety and retention suite with fail-closed promotion gating; and an evaluator-sealed confirmation executor that generates and scores real predictions under frozen rules. The executed positive control is REFUSED (6 of 7 readiness gates pass): the pipeline is mechanically correct and LoRA learns within-family, but it does not fit to the 95% bar and degrades the held-out families. No improvement claim is made. Campaign 3B.3 adds: exact-match-v2 strict oracle rescoring all retained predictions (v1 retained for provenance); an uncertainty-aware intervention selector whose decision taxonomy (RECOMMENDED/ELIGIBLE/INCONCLUSIVE/CONFOUNDED/INSUFFICIENT-EVIDENCE/FAILED-IMPLEMENTATION/REFUTED/HIGH-RISK) is reachable from evidence logic rather than decorative; optimization-time rehearsal and frozen-reference KL preservation in the trainer with receipt-bound corpus digests; a matched 4-condition x 3-seed P4 sweep; and a fail-closed production confirmation attempt (NOT_QUALIFIED on same-UID custody). The scientific verdict remains negative: no adaptation condition beats frozen inference under the strict oracle.
